prepare_output_recipe: prepare output from generated recipe token ids and ingredient ids using vocabularies and validate diversity
get_recipe_tokens: get recipe tokens by converting a list of token ids into words using a vocabulary
get_ingredients: get ingredient names from a list of ingredient ids using an ingredient vocabulary list
prettify_recipe_text: prettify a list of recipe tokens into readable sentences with proper capitalization and spacing
colorize_ingredient_list: colorize a list of generated ingredients green if in ground truth or red if not
